race.title: Donohue Marquees Risk Of Thunder Chase
race.verdict: STUMPTOWN is a very smart performer in cross-country events, winning 5 times including this race, at the Cheltenham Festival and the historic Velka Pardubicka, and he looks to hold strong claims after reappearing with a victory over hurdles. The biggest threat could come from Fountain House , while The Goffer is also considered. STUMPTOWN (IRE) FOUNTAIN HOUSE (IRE) THE GOFFER (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Stumptown (13/8), Desertmore House (6/1), Fountain House (7/1), Busselton (8/1), Outside The Door (8/1), The Goffer (10/1), Fakir D'Oudairies (10/1), The Short Go (12/1), Thatildojon (14/1), Union Station (20/1), Idy Wood (20/1), Caesar Rock (25/1), Three By Two (33/1), The Gallan (66/1), Fr Gilligansvoyge (100/1)
